preregistered.C0_mechanism: Reported, decides nothing about shipping: with the weekly de-seasonaliser in the fit window, robust_z's share of fit-window normal scores (after the 200-point warm-up) above the held-out calibration threshold is <= 0.01 on both 'weekend' and 'weekend_t3' (slice 9: 0.066 and 0.035).
preregistered.H1_pooled_weekly: The shipped robust_z static threshold switches to pooled_weekly iff, on 'weekend_t3' over seeds 600-609, mean event-F1(pooled_weekly - quantile) > 0 with pooled_weekly better on >= 7 of 10 seeds, AND on Gaussian 'weekend' mean event-F1(pooled_weekly - quantile) >= -0.01, AND pooled_weekly's mean realised false-alarm rate on normal test points of 'weekend_t3' is <= 0.0075 (slice 9's bar, unchanged).
preregistered.H2_guardrail: Under the rule H1 picks, robust_z mean F1 on 'weekend_t3' >= mean F1 on 'weekend' - 0.10.
preregistered.expectation: Written before the run, from dev seeds 150-152: C0 holds; H1 fails on the 7-of-10 t3 seeds part (dev t3 gains were split), while the Gaussian part passes; H2 fails.
preregistered.reported_not_decided: weekend_t5 and the two CUSUMs, whose fit-window scores stay wide (CUSUM state).
